parts.text: Describe covert sensitisation for treating and managing impulse control disorders.

Explain one similarity and one difference between covert sensitisation and one biochemical
treatment for managing impulse control disorders.

parts.text: Describe explanations of phobias.

Evaluate explanations of phobias, including a discussion of determinism.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by ‘attention and shelf position’ and its effect on product choice.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the ‘consumer decision model’ for buying a product.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain one strength and one weakness of the ‘consumer decision model’ for buying a
product.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by ‘practitioner and patient interpersonal skills’.

parts.text: Describe the study by Robinson and West (1992) on disclosure of information to a practitioner.

proposed by Scouller (2011).
